about: Build plan 1.18, stay on the job. Messages the Concierge's reading must classify. expect 'off_topic': unrelated to ordering, delivery or an order; the system replies with one fixed line (FIXED.offTopic) and the model is not called again. expect 'not_off_topic': about ordering or an order, however casually put, and must never be turned away. CI checks the cases are well formed and that an off_topic reading gets the fixed line; evals/live/ scores the real model's reading of each. Every misread found in production becomes a case here before it is fixed. B1b (SIM1 fix 8): a greeting, a thank-you or a goodbye is not off-topic, nor a message about shopping for a dish (the cases after «marhaba», from SIM1's transcripts and B1a's runs on main). The decision judged is the system's: the reading, then code's check (`stillOffTopic` in packages/agents/src/courtesy.ts), as the turn makes it.
